title: Scope.
officialText:
This chapter shall govern the approval, design, installation, construction, maintenance, alteration and repair of the
appliances and equipment specifically identified herein and factory-built fireplaces. The approval, design, installation,
construction, maintenance, alteration and repair of gas-fired appliances shall be regulated by the New York City Fuel Gas Code.
